title: Equation from a successful split
statement: Let $N$ and $i$ be natural numbers. If the bounded search with parameters $C=e=1$ returns $i$ on input $N$, then $i+(i+1)=N$.
hypotheses_covered: the bounded search with parameters $C=e=1$ returns $i$ on input $N$
replaced:
Let $N$ and $i$ be natural numbers. If the bounded split search with parameters
$(1,1)$ — which returns the least $i \le N$ with $i + (i+1) = N$, if any — returns
$i$ on $N$, then $i + (i + 1) = N$.
